name: Wisdom of the Sphinx
body:
Your knowledge of the primordial tongue aids you in understanding other languages and interpreting the grammar of magic.

Prerequisite: Linguistics 3 ranks, must speak Sphinx

Benefit: You gain a +2 competence bonus to Linguistics skill checks, Spellcraft skill checks to learn a new spell or decipher a scroll, and Use Magic Device skill checks to use a scroll with a spell of a higher level than you can cast.
